_help: Which T3 provider and model each role runs on when a chat makes a video (docs/t3-orchestrator.md). `next --project` prints these as the delegate_task target. provider is a T3 providerInstanceId (see T3's orchestrator_capabilities), or "inherit" to run every role on the chat's own model. strong: script writer and script reviewer; weak: every other role. roles overrides one role, e.g. "builder": {"providerInstanceId": "codex", "model": "gpt-6-luna"}; options are T3 model options, e.g. {"thinking": "high"}. One project can override a role with `project-set --model role=provider:model`.
